description: Cross-agent persistent memory: what one agent learns, any agent can recall. Call to store a discovery, decision, or warning, or to recall prior context before starting work.

agent_type.description: Agent identifier, e.g. claude_code, cursor, windsurf (for store)

expires_at.description: ISO datetime when this memory expires (for store, optional)

filter_agent.description: Filter results to a specific agent type (for recall, get_recent)

memory_type.description: Type of memory (for store). Default: context

query.description: Search term to match against subject and tags (for recall)

since.description: ISO datetime to get memories after (for get_recent)

subject.description: Short subject line for the memory (for store)

name: agent_memory
title: Agent memory
